summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Eurospec marketing site after 2026-style animation overhaul (framer-motion + lenis + react-fast-marquee). 7/7 pytest backend tests pass. All 5 pages + service detail render with zero JS/console errors. Scroll-reveal animations all end at opacity:1 after scroll (no stuck-invisible sections). All navigation flows, service cards, services tabs, contact form (with toast + reset), careers apply dialog (incl. experience Select), and mobile menu toggle work. Counters reach final values (40+, 250, 60M+, 35M).
passed_tests: Home page loads, hero heading 'Precision Engineering for Global Automotive' visible
home-service-tooling navigates to /services/tooling with matching content
/services page renders 6 service-tab-* tabs; tab switching works
All 6 routes load without console errors: /, /about, /services, /services/tooling, /careers, /contact
After scrolling each page, ZERO elements remain stuck at opacity 0 (reveal animations complete correctly)
Contact form: filled and submitted -> success toast 'Message Sent!' visible, form fields reset to empty
Careers: 5 apply-btn-* buttons; modal opens, apply-name/email/phone fillable
apply-experience Select dropdown opens, 4 options visible and selectable
apply-submit POST /api/apply returns success and toast appears
Mobile viewport (390x844): mobile-menu-toggle present, opens menu (shows nav links), closes on second tap
Smooth scroll (lenis) does not interfere — programmatic window.scrollTo works on all pages
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: send_email currently silently treats missing SMTP creds as success (returns True with a print). This matches the explicit 'mocked email' contract and is intentional, but worth a TODO comment so future devs don't think emails are actually being sent.
backend/server.py: CORS is open (allow_origins=['*']) — acceptable for a public marketing site, but consider restricting to the production domain before launch.
backend/.env exposes MAIL_TO (ashwinviyan@gmail.com) hardcoded as default in server.py too — keep only in .env.

frontend/src/App.jsx: ScrollToTop uses behavior:'instant' which is fine, but lenis is initialized in main.jsx — verify lenis instance is reset/scrolled on route change (not tested as broken, just an observation). Currently scrolling works after navigation.
Reveal/StaggerItem use viewport={{ once: true }} which is correct — prevents repeat re-fade. Verified no opacity-0 stuck sections after scroll.

Counter component: useEffect for spring.on('change') returns the unsubscribe directly inside an effect that doesn't return a cleanup function wrapper — minor: `useEffect(() => spring.on('change', ...))` returns the unsubscribe, which React treats as cleanup; this is fine but slightly non-obvious.
seed_data_creation: None — all test data prefixed with TEST_ and goes to mocked email endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: All animations work. Reveal sections end at opacity:1 after scroll; no stuck-invisible content. Contact + apply forms POST correctly and surface sonner toasts. Mobile menu toggle works. data-testids are correctly applied across hero CTA, home-service-*, service-card-*, service-tab-*, apply-btn-*, apply-name/email/phone/experience/resume/submit, contact-name/email/subject/message/submit. Backend email is intentionally mocked — do not chase SMTP failures.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in this iteration.
